title: Dice Combinations
statement: Your task is to count the number of ways to construct sum n by throwing a dice one or more times. Each throw produces an outcome between 1 and 6.

title: Minimizing Coins
statement: You have n coins with certain values. Your task is to produce a sum of money x using the available coins in such a way that the number of coins is minimal.

title: Coin Combinations I
statement: Consider a money system consisting of n coins. Your task is to calculate the number of distinct ordered ways you can produce a money sum x using the available coins.

title: Coin Combinations II
statement: Consider a money system consisting of n coins. Your task is to calculate the number of distinct ways you can produce a money sum x using the available coins. The order of coins does not matter.

title: Removing Digits
statement: You are given an integer n. On each step, you may subtract one of the digits from the number. Your task is to make the number equal to 0 using the minimum number of steps.

title: Grid Paths
statement: Consider an n by n grid whose squares may have traps. Your task is to calculate the number of paths from the upper-left to the lower-right corner moving only right or down.

title: Book Shop
statement: You are in a book shop which sells n different books. You know the price and number of pages of each book. You have a total of x euros to use. Find the maximum number of pages you can buy.

title: Array Description
statement: You know that an array has n integers between 1 and m, and the absolute difference between two adjacent values is at most 1. Some values may be unknown (marked 0). Count the number of valid arrays.

title: Edit Distance
statement: Calculate the edit distance between two strings: minimum number of insert, remove, or modify operations to transform one string into another.

title: Increasing Subsequence
statement: Given an array of n integers, find the length of the longest increasing subsequence.

title: Message Route
statement: Find the shortest route from node 1 to node n in an unweighted graph and print the path.

title: Building Teams
statement: Given a graph of n people and m friendship edges, divide them into 2 teams so that no two friends are on the same team. Print the team of each person or IMPOSSIBLE.

title: Shortest Routes I
statement: Find the shortest route from node 1 to all other nodes in a directed graph with non-negative weights.

title: Shortest Routes II
statement: Given a directed graph with weighted edges, process q queries: for each pair (a, b), find the shortest path from a to b.

title: Road Reparation
statement: Given an undirected weighted graph, find the minimum cost to make the graph connected (minimum spanning tree).

title: Sum of Two Values
statement: Given an array of n integers, find two values whose sum is x.

title: Playlist
statement: Given a playlist of n songs, find the longest sequence of consecutive songs where each song is unique.

title: Factory Machines
statement: n machines, each takes a different time to make a product. Find the minimum time to make t products.

title: Array Division
statement: Given an array of n integers, divide it into k subarrays so that the maximum sum of a subarray is minimized.

title: Distinct Numbers
statement: You are given a list of n integers, count the number of distinct values.
